_doc: ENRICHMENT SOURCES — per facet, which connector authoritatively serves
it, in precedence order, and the tier band its output lands at.
The facets are the ledger's seven (FACETS in apps/mcp/dma_mcp/ledger.py
and migration 0051) plus thought_leadership, which the enrichment
register tracks as a surface (overview.thought_leadership in
packages/shared/enrichment_register.json) but the ledger does not
version.
`status` is grounded in the repo, not in intent:
wired                 a code path or producer-session connector exists
and is named in `grounding`
wired, not live       declared in code that records NOT_RUN with a
reason until a missing credential exists
declared, not wired   named in a skill or plan only — no code path,
no repo consumer. Listing it here grants nothing.
Nothing in this file opens a path into serving content. Whatever the
connector, the value travels the only path content may take: registered
through register_evidence citing the SOURCE the tool surfaced — never
the tool — and submitted through the connector (invariant 2). Tier
bands follow the underlying source per 02-inputs/clay_taxonomy.json and
01-start-here/2-evidence.md; a value with no traceable source is an
inference at any tier.
Sources are ordered: the first entry is the one to try first, and a
later entry supplements rather than replaces an earlier one.
`search_connectors` are the two SEARCH connectors the research tier
runs on. They serve no facet of their own — they find the SOURCE a
facet then cites — which is why they were missing from the facet table
(QA audit F-L11-042 pair 4) although the tier uses them most. Who holds
them is `scripts/provision_agent_tools.py` (repo root); the order is
RESEARCH-PROTOCOL.md § Tools.

sources.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-23, and the previous note was costing every run its technographics. It read 'Ingest-scan only — no live API: the key is not in Secret Manager, and the routine records NOT_RUN with that reason until it is', which conflated TWO paths. The ingest scan does need a Secret Manager key and does not have one. The PRODUCER SESSION does not use a key at all — Vibe Prospecting/Explorium is an MCP connector authenticated at the session, its read-only calls (fetch-entities) are auto-approved by ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hooks/autoapprove_connector.py, and its billed calls (match-business, enrich-business, 2 credits per enrichment per row) open only on the run's owner-written approval record, `engine.cli approve` -> 07_qa/approvals.json with the quoted cost (QA audit F-K01-003, 28-09-2026) — and it answers. Measured 2026-08-23 on three promoted clients: baxter-credit-union 392 premium technologies, axos-bank 357, logix-federal-credit-union 147, each broken into ~20 named categories (finance, IT security, platform and storage, BI and analytics, ...) and naming real core systems — Symitar Episys and Temenos for Baxter, Symitar Episys and Fiserv and FICO Falcon for Logix, Jack Henry SilverLake and nCino and Yodlee for Axos. Cost is 2 credits per enrichment per row. So a producer recording NOT_RUN for this facet was recording it for a source it could reach, which is how a register reaches a client with ten named products. WHAT EXPLORIUM IS FOR: it is the CANDIDATE LIST that makes the recursive search converge, not the citation. The tool console (vibeprospecting.explorium.ai) is still never a citable source (scripts/check_evidence.py TOOL_HOSTS) — each candidate is corroborated through a job posting, the entity's newsroom, a vendor release or a live technical read, and carries CONFIRMED/INFERRED/CLAIMED accordingly. 2026-10-04 (SWBC gold audit RC-07): the techstack Clay/Explorium scans were recorded 'NOT_RUN, no binding' and nothing blocked. A connector-bound scan the run could not bind is a blocked PREFLIGHT, named by the session's binding check (plugins/dma-insights/scripts/connector_contract.py check; scripts/preflight.py step Bind), never a silent NOT_RUN on the register.

search_connectors._rule: A category lane holds neither: it EMITS a connector volley as a search_requests entry and the servicing tier fires it, logging the search with the tool that ran it (RESEARCH-PROTOCOL.md § Tools).
search_connectors._failover_rule: A refused, rate-limited (402/429) or credit-exhausted provider hands the request to the next one in _failover, in order. A rung is NOT_RUN only when the whole chain failed, and it then names every provider tried with each one's refusal. SWBC gold audit 2026-10-04 (RC-07, D-22): on 2026-10-01 Exa/Tavily/Firecrawl credit ran out and 281 H3 alerts, the I1 contradictory probes and the techstack ABSENT search all recorded NOT_RUN with no failover tried. 01-start-here/4-absence-protocol.md § A refusal hands over.
